items.stem: When are an agent's success criteria supposed to be defined?

options.text: During planning, before the build, so measurement has a target.
After launch, once usage patterns emerge.
Only if the customer requests a business case.

items.stem: Which usage metrics should be tracked?

options.text: Agent runs, distinct users, frequency of use, and engagement patterns over time.
Only the total number of agents created.

items.stem: What can high abandonment or declining usage indicate?

options.text: That the agent is working as intended.
That the model needs to be larger.

items.stem: Which test case set matches the fallback requirement?

options.text: Out-of-scope and low-confidence questions that must trigger defined fallback behaviour.
Only questions well inside the defined source set.

items.stem: What happens to measurement insights at the end of the loop?

options.text: They feed directly back into planning, and successful agents become templates.
They are archived once the project closes.
They replace the need for future discovery workshops.
